Formosa Advanced Technologies.why: Memory back-end OEM: packages and tests DRAM ICs and assembles memory modules, mainly for Nanya Technology (71% of 2025 net sales); AI-driven DRAM tightness (HBM/DDR5 crowding out DDR4) is lifting its packaging/test volumes, OEM prices and capex (TSV, bumping, chip stacking at its new Factory 5).
Formosa Advanced Technologies.evidence: Formosa Advanced Technologies 2025 annual report: customers above 10% of sales - Nanya Technology (related party) NT$7,042,085 thousand, 71% of 2025 net sales (76% in 2024, 77% in Q1 2026); the company provides one-stop chip probing, assembly, final test and module services.

players.product: DRAM IC packaging and testing (wafer probe, assembly, final test) and DRAM memory module (DIMM) assembly - turn-key memory back-end OEM services
